caption: The drawing depicts a metal object with a rectangular, grid-like base composed of parallel bars supported by four legs, each ending in a slight outward bend. Attached to one side of the rectangular base is a long, curved handle that extends upward and outward, with an additional circular grip incorporated into its design. The drawing is rendered in grayscale on an off-white or beige background, and the object is detailed with shading to indicate its three-dimensional form, metallic texture, and the cast of light. The composition centers the object on the page, with empty space surrounding it and no additional elements present.
title: Gridiron
